title: feat(objectql): the lifecycle sweep keeps a last-swept watermark in sys_lifecycle_state, so a reboot skips a sweep the interval has not come due for
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D9gB7dhaBzxAcWk95SYN9CE)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxAY2io7s5aVJa6YL4

Fixes #29918
Fixes #30641

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']` (and with it `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_OBJECT_NAMES` / `isPlatformProvidedObjectName`) lists one more real platform object, `sys_lifecycle_state`, and the exported `LifecycleEngineLike` gains three optional members (`findOne`, `insert`, `update`); nothing that was accepted is refused.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` enumerate no platform-object roster and teach nothing about the lifecycle sweep's schedule; the object is internal clock state with no data API, so there is nothing for an author to write against it.

Claim: 6672243354 (amended 6672382820) · Branch: `claude/project-thread-ie3sda` · Ruling-ref: 6663872259 (letter B), confirmed 6670551310 · Claim correction: 6670586478 · Spec consent: 6669304514, 6670346930 · Resumes: release 6671108523 (`claude/project-thread-0jjbbb@4a9c5296`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：objectql 生命周期清扫记住「上次扫完的时间」，存在新的系统状态对象 `sys_lifecycle_state`（引擎自有、无租户列、每个数据库一行）。内核启动 60 秒时读这一行：距上次扫完不到一小时就不扫，只花这一条读；超过一小时、没有这一行、读失败，照旧扫。全新建库那一轮仍按 #30214 延后一个间隔，并顺手写下这一行。spec 名册加一行 `sys_lifecycle_state`，与对象同一提交。
- 为什么改：每次内核重启都会在第一分钟跑满一遍清扫（cloud 托管内核上 130 条语句），cloud#3413 要求第一分钟不超过约 10 条。裁决 B（6663872259，确认 6670551310）：水位线是引擎状态，不是设置。
- 风险与回滚：小。最坏情况是水位线写不进去，下次启动多扫一遍（等于今天的行为），写失败只记一次 warn。新增一个系统表（无数据 API、无设置键、无环境变量、不进 Setup）。回滚即撤 PR，多出的空表无害。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts`（`runFirstScheduledSweep`、`watermarkIsYoung`、`writeWatermark`，以及 `sweep()` 末尾只在完整成功时推进水位线），`packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-lifecycle-state.object.ts`，`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts` 那一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.test.ts -t "sweep watermark"`，预期 9 条全绿，其中「younger than the interval」断言初始延迟时只发出一次读。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/objectql` — `LifecycleService`** (`lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts`)

- New exported constants `LIFECYCLE_STATE_OBJECT = 'sys_lifecycle_state'` and `LIFECYCLE_STATE_ROW_ID = 'lifecycle'`.
- `LifecycleEngineLike` gains optional `findOne` / `insert` / `update`. An engine missing any of the three, or whose registry does not register `sys_lifecycle_state`, keeps no watermark and sweeps exactly as before; the object is never read when unregistered.
- The scheduler's first tick (`runFirstScheduledSweep`):
  1. a store this boot created from empty (#30214's `wasDatastoreCreatedFromEmpty`) still defers one interval, and now seeds the row at now without reading it;
  2. otherwise one primary-key `findOne` of the row: a `last_swept_at` younger than the interval ⇒ no sweep, the read is the only statement; the interval is armed either way;
  3. an older, missing, unparsable or future watermark, or a read that throws (logged once at `warn`) ⇒ sweep at the initial delay, as before.
- `sweep()` advances the row (insert the first time, update after; the row's presence is remembered so no second read) only for a COMPLETED sweep: no policy error, the reference-audit leg ran (or was never meant to), and no teardown cut it short. Stamped with the sweep's start, which the cutoffs were taken from. A failed write is a functional degradation (the next boot sweeps again), logged at `warn` once and `debug` after, never thrown.
- A direct `sweep()` call always sweeps. `OS_LIFECYCLE_DISABLED=1` still arms nothing.

**`@objectstack/platform-objects`** — new `sys_lifecycle_state` (`system/sys-lifecycle-state.object.ts`): `isSystem`, `managedBy: 'engine-owned'`, `systemFields: { tenant: false }` (ADR-0131 D7 deployment-level state), `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`, `apiEnabled: false`, no `lifecycle` block (never swept), fields `id`, `last_swept_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Registered by `PlatformObjectsPlugin` beside `sys_migration` and exported from `system/index.ts`.

**`@objectstack/spec`** — the one roster line `'sys_lifecycle_state'` in `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']` (sorted between `sys_jwks` and `sys_member`), in the same commit as the object, per `domain:spec#3`'s consent (6669304514, 6670346930): the roster test holds the roster to the declared `*.object.ts` set both ways, so #30641 cannot land alone. Nothing else under `packages/spec` moves.

**`@objectstack/cli`** — `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_INVENTORY` gains the `sys_lifecycle_state` row (deployment-level, `column-drop`).

**`scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json`** — the new row (`reach: out`, `systemFields.tenant: false`) and the totals (registered 94, out of reach 47).

**Changeset** — `minor` for spec / objectql / platform-objects / cli / plugin-audit, carrying both declaration lines and the `Skills-docs:` line.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.test.ts`, new describe "LifecycleService sweep watermark (#29918)", 9 pins: a younger watermark issues only the read; an interval-old watermark sweeps and advances; no row sweeps and writes it; a created-from-empty store defers, seeds without reading, and sweeps one interval later; a failed policy or a throwing audit leaves the row unchanged; a failing read sweeps and warns; an engine without the object is never asked; a direct `sweep()` sweeps and advances; `OS_LIFECYCLE_DISABLED` reads and writes nothing.
- `packages/platform-objects`: `plugin.test.ts` (registration order, six infra objects, no routing triple), `deployment-level-no-tenant-column.test.ts` (no tenant column, platform-only reads).
- Roster (`platform-object-names.test.ts`) and CLI inventory (`organization-ownership-inventory.test.ts`) unchanged and green with the new rows.

## Acceptance notes

- **The carried head is one commit.** The released branch held the object (`28a633a3`) and the roster line (`2de76a73`) in two commits; the dispatch order requires them in one because the roster test holds both directions, so this branch squashes the released work onto current `main` (`6ef7f583`). The released branch is untouched.
- **Docblock reattached.** On the released head, `runFirstScheduledSweep`'s docblock had been inserted between `firstSweepDueAtInitialDelay`'s docblock and its method, leaving that method undocumented and two docblocks stacked; this branch moves the new methods above it. No code moved.
- **`Skills-docs:` spelling.** The release and the dispatch order spelled the value `no move`; the declared grammar (pm-dispatch SKILL.md) is `updated here | follow-up owed — FILES | follow-up #N | none — REASON`, so the changeset and this body say `none — REASON` with the same reason.
- **A fresh store now issues one write at the initial delay** (the seed insert), not zero. The card's done-when allows "at most the watermark read"; the seed is the price of making a reboot inside the first interval skip too (card Expected item 2). One statement against the 130 measured.
- **plugin-audit hunk (amendment 6673909090).** The first head's watermark writes were audited like any business write, so every completed sweep added a `sys_audit_log` and a `sys_activity` row about its own clock, which the next sweep archived (CI: the `audit-key-material` / `audit-mail-bodies` archive integration tests counted 2 archived rows where 1 is right). Ruling 6663872259 forbids an audit row per sweep and ADR-0057 section 3.3 forbids cleanup re-feeding the tables it drains. No write option bypasses the code-registered audit hooks and there is no object-level opt-out, so `sys_lifecycle_state` joins `SKIP_OBJECTS` beside `sys_job_queue`; `audit-writers.test.ts` pins zero rows for its insert and update, and the changeset gains `'@objectstack/plugin-audit': minor`.
